description: This source file defines an abstract base class `PdfButtonField` for button-related form fields within a PDF document, such as checkboxes and radio buttons, in the PDFsharp library. It provides constructors, methods for retrieving appearance-related values, and internal APIs for managing field names.

classes.name: PdfButtonField
classes.description: Abstract base class for all button form fields in a PDF document, providing common functionality like retrieving appearance states and managing field names.

methods.name: GetNonOffValue
methods.description: Retrieves the appearance name that is not /Off from the button's appearance dictionary, indicating an active or selected state.

methods.name: GetDescendantNames
methods.description: Overrides method to add the partial name with the field's full name to the list, aiding in hierarchical naming of form fields.
